## Blog posts
- [Topshe: a local browser model, with clear boundaries](https://saswatasg.com/blog/topshe-browser-voice-ai): Building a browser-local language-model experiment, while separating model privacy from speech APIs and planned integrations.
- [TGB Hunt: outreach workflows and automation limits](https://saswatasg.com/blog/tgb-hunt-linkedin-outreach-agent): A self-hosted outreach experiment: task orchestration, campaign state and the limits of automated platform actions.
- [DhanPlan: monthly planning with visible assumptions](https://saswatasg.com/blog/dhanplan-retirement-calculator): How DhanPlan connects Indian savings instruments, retirement withdrawals, gap-solving and stress scenarios in a versioned monthly model.
- [AI image greetings lifted feature engagement by 168%](https://saswatasg.com/blog/ai-send-greetings-168): A dormant 'Send Greetings' feature, an image-gen model, and a festival calendar across 27 occasions — feature engagement up 168% at LiveKeeping.
- [The 17:1 e-way bill gap: diagnosing B2B adoption](https://saswatasg.com/blog/e-invoice-adoption-gap): A workflow investigation at LiveKeeping identified 17:1 and 19:1 adoption gaps and informed executive product discussions.
- [Discovery that continues into solution delivery](https://saswatasg.com/blog/discovery-to-roadmap): Building discovery at Upcore Technologies: structured research, opportunity prioritization and end-to-end solution delivery ownership for 23+ clients.
- [FilmRisk.AI: what a weak backtest changed](https://saswatasg.com/blog/film-risk-engine): A film-risk experiment with temporal validation, weak baseline comparisons and explicit data limits. What the evaluation changed.
- [Lead routing: observed signals and explicit pilot targets](https://saswatasg.com/blog/lead-routing-gold-silver-bronze): Designing a tiered lead-allocation system at Sierra Living Concepts, separating observed source performance from pilot targets.
- [How a form fix lifted lead submissions by 124% in 28 days](https://saswatasg.com/blog/lead-form-overhaul-124): A field-by-field form teardown with GA4 events and Clarity — one restrictive field caused 23% of drop-offs. The fix raised submissions +124% in 28 days.
- [The cheapest e-commerce CRO: ship one fix a week](https://saswatasg.com/blog/one-fix-a-week-cro): 17 boring fixes beat one big redesign. Weekly micro-forensics on checkout, forms and search — each measured — compound faster than a quarterly splash.
- [The data deep-dive: 480K sessions to three real problems](https://saswatasg.com/blog/data-deep-dive-method): The method behind the Sierra checkout teardown: instrument the funnel first, form ranked hypotheses second, never optimize an unmeasured funnel.
- [Daily report automation: 3 sources, 88 rows, 11 AM](https://saswatasg.com/blog/daily-report-automation): A Google Apps Script pipeline unifying Kibana, MongoDB, and GA4 into one auto-populated report — what white-collar automation really costs.
- [27 push notification triggers, 5 regions, one architecture](https://saswatasg.com/blog/push-notification-architecture): Designing a notification system across renewals, transactional states, and conflict logic — with priority tiers and a daily cap users don't hate.
- [Category page redesign that added +34% qualified leads](https://saswatasg.com/blog/category-page-redesign-plus34): Story-led category journeys beat commodity grids: +17% PDP clicks, +34% qualified leads, −16% bounce in a 4-week sprint at Sierra.
- [How we cut checkout abandonment from 73.1% to 53.9%](https://saswatasg.com/blog/checkout-abandonment-73-to-54): A 480K-session teardown: three separate checkout problems hidden behind one dashboard number, three targeted fixes, two sprints — −26% abandonment.
